svg.aria-label: Queen 2.3.0 and Kafka 4.3.1 on the same three GCP brokers: p99 end-to-end latency and broker CPU against the partition count, at 3M msg/s of 256-byte messages and at 1M msg/s of 1 KB messages

text.font-family: 'Inter Variable', Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif

svg.text: Queen 2.3.0 vs Kafka 4.3.1 on NVMe: one queue or topic from 10 to 10M partitions

text.font-family: 'Inter Variable', Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif

svg.text: The same six GCP VMs, 2026-10-14: three c4-standard-24-lssd brokers (24 vCPU, 88 GB, four local NVMe disks in RAID0) and three 16-vCPU load generators

text.font-family: 'Inter Variable', Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif
'Inter Variable', Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif

svg.text: Kafka: p99 7.5 to 21 ms up to 10k partitions, 105 ms at 25k, not carried at 50k. Queen: 42 to 76 ms, flat to 10M

text.font-family: 'Inter Variable', Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif
'Inter Variable', Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif

svg.text: Kafka: p99 9.4 to 19 ms up to 10k partitions, 45 ms at 25k, not carried at 50k. Queen: 26 to 47 ms, flat to 10M
